profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a publicly traded software company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, that reported revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, and trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CRM. The company operates Slack, a workplace messaging platform, alongside its broader customer relationship management and business intelligence offerings.

On the AI side, Salesforce tracks three principal products. Slack AI is embedded directly in the Slack messaging platform and the company describes it as able to summarize channels and threads, generate daily recaps, translate conversations, take meeting notes, and automate workflows, with customer data kept within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud and not used to train the underlying large language models. Slackbot is described as a personal AI agent within Slack that adapts to a user's tone and voice to help with meeting preparation, report analysis, and project briefs. Slack also serves as the conversational interface for Agentforce, Salesforce's broader CRM-embedded AI and agents platform, which can run directly in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages. Tableau AI, branded under the Einstein name, provides AI capabilities embedded in Salesforce's business intelligence product, including natural language queries, CRM data integration, and a Trust Layer governance component.

The held facts show no litigation on record for Salesforce. The company has a presence in the MCP server registry through several third-party servers, including tools for Salesforce administration, SOQL querying against Salesforce organizations, and a DevOps server for planning deployments and triggering pipelines from an AI client.
